app_not_on_canvas: That is not on this canvas.
app_delete_app_body: Its folder, apps/{folder}, moves to the deck's trash, and the items showing it leave the canvases.
app_notes_not_built: Notes on a component are not built yet.
app_picture_failed: The picture could not be taken: {error}
app_no_card_at: No card at {path}: the link points at something this deck does not have.
app_own_copy: {name} is your own copy: change it as you like. It never changes theirs.
app_wants_goto: {name} wants to take you to the canvas {canvas}
app_clear_canvas_ask_title: Remove all {count} cards from this canvas?
app_clear_canvas_ask_body: The cards come off the canvas. Their folders stay in the deck, and the drawing stays.
